title: Emotet malware campaign
rawTitle: TTCSIRT-239.102519: TT-CSIRT ADVISORY – EMOTET MALWARE CAMPAIGN
leadParagraph: The Australian Cyber Security Centre (ACSC) has released an advisory on an ongoing, widespread Emotet malware campaign. Emotet is a Trojan—commonly spread via malicious email attachments—that attempts to proliferate within a network by brute forcing user credentials and writing to shared drives. ACSC provides indicators of compromise (IOCs) and recommendations to help organizations defend against Emotet malware. TTCSIRT encourages users and administrators to review the following advisory from ACSC and implement the necessary remediation actions:
